label: A Perspective on Observation as Intervention in Chronic Diagnostic Complexity.
summary: This patient perspective article advances observation as an intentional, rigorous form of clinical care rather than a passive absence of intervention. The recommendations arise from the lived experience of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS), informed by clinical training as a mobile equine veterinarian.
